propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 section before Phase 1 to search the tracker for existing duplicate reports and establish the reported-against version

The skill does not mandate checking whether reported-against version is present in the bug description/comments or deriving a floor from the ticket's created_at timestamp (nanoseconds, requiring division by 1e9 for git)
The nanosecond created_at value, if passed directly to git --before=, silently returns the tip instead of a historical floor, masking the true build range
Step 0 must confirm worktree currency (HEAD == origin/main) before proceeding and record the status explicitly
The approval gate does not pre-authorize the Step-0 duplicates link writebacks, creating a conflict with the skill's own instructions
The tracker sweep must include closed tickets (759 of 764 bug tickets are closed) rather than filtering by open status alone
